nodes.name: Invite signer once

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ fileId: $('Verify created').first().json.fileId, signers: [{ email: $('Prepare request').first().json.signerEmail }] }) }}

nodes.notes: Assign the same dedicated Nextcloud Generic HTTP Basic Auth credential after import. Do not enable automatic retries.

parameters.jsCode:
const c = $('Prepare request').first().json;
return Array.from({ length: c.maxAttempts }, (_, i) => ({ json: { attempt: i + 1 } }));

nodes.name: Poll attempts
nodes.notes: Output 1 processes a poll. Output 0 is intentionally unused; final success exits from Signed? directly.

nodes.name: Get file state

nodes.name: Wait before polling
nodes.notes: Not a notification-delivery guarantee. Once the budget is exhausted, fail explicitly.

nodes.name: Download signed PDF

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Prepare request').first().json; return c.baseUrl + '/remote.php/dav/files/' + encodeURIComponent(c.integrationUser) + '/' + c.signedPdfPath.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/'); })() }}

nodes.notes: Use a verified path under the integration account DAV root, with file read access.
